Tasks to assess

  • Hydropower sumps with suitable vehicle access
  • Confined submerged spaces with an assessed sediment profile
  • Projects with a defined discharge and treatment arrangement
Read the application guide

Configuration checks

  • Provide particle size, solids content, debris and sediment depth.
  • Calculate lift, conveyance distance and pipe routing.
  • Define clogging management, recovered material measurement and retrieval.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

The 5 m³/h figure relates to the supporting mud-water separation equipment. It is not a verified net sediment-removal rate. Confirm performance with representative sediment and the full pump-and-pipe system.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle and installed payload
  • Control station and software functions
  • Tether length, reel and power supply
  • Selected tools, sensors and deployment equipment
  • Transport cases, spares, manuals and training

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.
